status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; revised by issue #523 (ADR-0040); read by scripts/contracts/contract.sh and the module's command. Format: scripts/contracts/contract.sh, header.
goal: The pull request reviewed by every configured reviewer, and one aggregated verdict over their reviews: each finding once, with its severity and whether it holds.

reviews.note: one per configured reviewer that ran; a reviewer unavailable for the round is named with the reason in the findings, and the round goes on without it (docs/units/review.md > An unreadable operator file)

evaluation: each finding of the reviews once, with the reviewers that raised it, its severity (docs/review/review.md > Severity) and whether it holds, a finding that does not hold with its grounds
every finding of every review is in the file

comment.note: the round's aggregated comment, in Korean

failure.note: Written instead of the expected output when the run does not reach its goal: what the run did and why it did not reach the goal — an input it needed and was not given named as such. check-out then writes `failed` (docs/core.md > Development Lifecycle; ADR-0040 D1).

default: The comment posted on the pull request (docs/units/review.md > Review aggregation).
